fact: Ordonnance n°0011/PR/2026 of 26 February 2026, published in Journal Officiel n°110 of 8-15 April 2026, forbids deepfakes of persons in sexual situations or attributing false statements to public figures and requires AI-generated content to be visibly and permanently marked, with platforms given twelve months to comply.
title: GABON : Trois ordonnances encadrent désormais les influenceurs, l'usage des réseaux sociaux, l'IA, et le rôle reformé de l'Autorité de la Communication
